title: The Legend of the Mystical Ninja - Otafuku Army Headquarters (Reversible Room)
description:
A japanese temple background from The Legend of the Mystical Ninja. It is used the main room of the Otafuku Army Headquarters.

A good fit for temples, in general.

UPDATE: Optimized it even further, making it use less tiles and more close to the source material. Better palette management, as well.
